assets.description_en: Hold a first idea without closing off its possibilities.
assets.description_zh: 容纳最初的想法，也留下继续变化的空间。

description.en: Hold a first idea without closing off its possibilities.
description.zh: 容纳最初的想法，也留下继续变化的空间。

assets.description_en: Gather different perspectives into one refracted view.
assets.description_zh: 收集不同视角，让同一问题显出更多层次。

description.en: Gather different perspectives into one refracted view.
description.zh: 收集不同视角，让同一问题显出更多层次。

assets.description_en: Catch a promising fragment before it disappears.
assets.description_zh: 在灵感消失之前，轻轻把它接住。

description.en: Catch a promising fragment before it disappears.
description.zh: 在灵感消失之前，轻轻把它接住。

assets.description_en: Keep small observations with their own texture and shape.
assets.description_zh: 保留细小观察各自的质感和轮廓。

description.en: Keep small observations with their own texture and shape.
description.zh: 保留细小观察各自的质感和轮廓。

assets.description_en: Make room for a reference that changes the surrounding ideas.
assets.description_zh: 为一条能够影响周围想法的参考留出位置。

description.en: Make room for a reference that changes the surrounding ideas.
description.zh: 为一条能够影响周围想法的参考留出位置。

assets.description_en: Keep a small layered collection that can be revisited.
assets.description_zh: 保存一组有层次、可以反复回看的收藏。

description.en: Keep a small layered collection that can be revisited.
description.zh: 保存一组有层次、可以反复回看的收藏。

assets.description_en: Let separate contributions meet around a shared center.
assets.description_zh: 让各自的贡献围绕共同中心相遇。

description.en: Let separate contributions meet around a shared center.
description.zh: 让各自的贡献围绕共同中心相遇。

assets.description_en: Let complementary directions make a shared space.
assets.description_zh: 让互补的方向共同围出一片空间。

description.en: Let complementary directions make a shared space.
description.zh: 让互补的方向共同围出一片空间。

assets.description_en: Connect separate contributions without flattening their differences.
assets.description_zh: 连接彼此的贡献，同时保留各自的差异。

description.en: Connect separate contributions without flattening their differences.
description.zh: 连接彼此的贡献，同时保留各自的差异。

assets.description_en: Interweave several routes into a continuous process.
assets.description_zh: 把几条路径交织成持续推进的过程。

description.en: Interweave several routes into a continuous process.
description.zh: 把几条路径交织成持续推进的过程。

assets.description_en: Allow two inputs to overlap and create a third reading.
assets.description_zh: 让两种输入交叠，产生第三种理解。

description.en: Allow two inputs to overlap and create a third reading.
description.zh: 让两种输入交叠，产生第三种理解。

assets.description_en: Bring independent ideas into a common rhythm.
assets.description_zh: 让独立的想法进入共同的节奏。

description.en: Bring independent ideas into a common rhythm.
description.zh: 让独立的想法进入共同的节奏。

assets.description_en: Turn a continuous thought through a useful change of direction.
assets.description_zh: 让连续的思路经过一次有用的转折。

description.en: Turn a continuous thought through a useful change of direction.
description.zh: 让连续的思路经过一次有用的转折。

assets.description_en: Give a loose direction a supportive first structure.
assets.description_zh: 为松散的方向建立第一层有用结构。

description.en: Give a loose direction a supportive first structure.
description.zh: 为松散的方向建立第一层有用结构。

assets.description_en: Refine a form through visible layers rather than one final leap.
assets.description_zh: 通过清晰可见的层次，逐步修整一个形态。

description.en: Refine a form through visible layers rather than one final leap.
description.zh: 通过清晰可见的层次，逐步修整一个形态。

assets.description_en: Use a boundary that can adapt as the idea grows.
assets.description_zh: 让边界随想法的成长保有调整余地。

description.en: Use a boundary that can adapt as the idea grows.
description.zh: 让边界随想法的成长保有调整余地。

assets.description_en: Keep a changing idea coherent from one stage to the next.
assets.description_zh: 让不断变化的想法在不同阶段保持连贯。

description.en: Keep a changing idea coherent from one stage to the next.
description.zh: 让不断变化的想法在不同阶段保持连贯。

assets.description_en: Turn a flat possibility into a form with direction.
assets.description_zh: 把平面的可能性折成带有方向的形态。

description.en: Turn a flat possibility into a form with direction.
description.zh: 把平面的可能性折成带有方向的形态。

assets.description_en: Adjust the next version with a measured response.
assets.description_zh: 借助反馈，为下一版本做适度调整。

description.en: Adjust the next version with a measured response.
description.zh: 借助反馈，为下一版本做适度调整。

assets.description_en: Send a shared idea outward in more than one direction.
assets.description_zh: 把共同形成的想法送向不同方向。

description.en: Send a shared idea outward in more than one direction.
description.zh: 把共同形成的想法送向不同方向。

assets.description_en: Give the next version a clear and open path forward.
assets.description_zh: 给下一版本留出清楚、开放的前进路径。

description.en: Give the next version a clear and open path forward.
description.zh: 给下一版本留出清楚、开放的前进路径。

assets.description_en: Let a compact contribution open into several useful responses.
assets.description_zh: 让一份小小的贡献展开为多种有用回应。

description.en: Let a compact contribution open into several useful responses.
description.zh: 让一份小小的贡献展开为多种有用回应。

assets.description_en: Show how a shared result reaches beyond the original group.
assets.description_zh: 让共同成果的影响逐渐走出最初的小组。

description.en: Show how a shared result reaches beyond the original group.
description.zh: 让共同成果的影响逐渐走出最初的小组。

assets.description_en: Send a first version out while leaving room for the next one.
assets.description_zh: 送出第一版，同时为下一版留下空间。

description.en: Send a first version out while leaving room for the next one.
